pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against opening multiple correlated micro-lots within a 5-minute window to eliminate accidental averaging into falling or rising knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero new order execution permitted unless the ATR-adjusted volatility filter confirms divergence from high-impact liquidity wicks and spread expansion.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively lock in gains via trailing stops once profit crosses +$10.00 to prevent floating profits from evaporating.
